full_prompt_en: A square atmospheric city painting shows a tram advancing along wet cobblestones at blue hour. The street runs from the lower left toward a distant central opening, with narrow rail lines converging beneath the tram. Tall stone buildings enclose both sides: the left facade has stacked bay windows and a pointed corner tower, while the right forms a darker continuous wall. Far in the middle distance, a larger domed building and smaller spires rise in mist against a violet-blue evening sky. The tram occupies the center, its dark green body and warm interior windows outlined by small lamps. Two older dark cars are parked along the left curb. A few small pedestrians gather near the buildings, and one dark figure stands on the right sidewalk near a lamppost. Repeated streetlights cast amber circles on the facades and long broken reflections across the damp stones. A low planted island fills the near right foreground, its dark foliage bordered by a pale curb. Cool indigo and slate blue cover the sky, masonry, and road, while lit windows and lamps punctuate them with gold. The brushwork is detailed enough to make the stone blocks, windows, and tram readable but softens distant structures into a hazy silhouette. Overcast twilight supplies a cool ambient base; the lamps provide localized warm light that glows on wet pavement without hard shadows. The overall composition is deep and cinematic, leading the eye along reflective rails between shadowed vertical facades toward the distant illuminated dome.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形氛围感城市绘画呈现一辆电车在蓝调时刻沿湿润鹅卵石街道前行。街道从左下向远处中央开口延伸，狭窄轨道线在电车下方汇聚。高大石建筑从两侧围拢：左侧立面有层层凸窗与尖顶角楼，右侧则是一道较暗的连续墙面。中远处，一座更大的穹顶建筑和几座小尖塔在薄雾里升起，衬着紫蓝色暮空。电车位于中央，深绿色车身和温暖的车内窗光由小灯勾出。两辆旧式深色汽车停在左侧路缘。少数小行人聚在建筑附近，一名深色人物站在右侧路灯旁的人行道上。重复路灯把琥珀色光圈洒在立面上，并在湿石面上拉出长而破碎的倒影。靠右近前景是一座低矮种植岛，深色枝叶被浅色路缘围住。冷靛蓝和石板蓝覆盖天空、石墙与道路，亮窗和路灯则以金色点缀。笔法细到足以辨认石块、窗户和电车，却让远处建筑软化成朦胧剪影。阴天暮光提供冷调环境底色，路灯给出局部暖光，在湿路面上发亮而不形成硬影。整体构图纵深且有电影感，沿反光轨道把视线带过阴暗的竖向立面，抵达远处被照亮的穹顶。
style_prompt_en: The painted image relies on a deep blue-hour range of indigo, slate, violet-gray, and small amber-gold lights. Tall dark masses form a corridor around a central receding gap, while repeated narrow verticals and converging lines pull the eye inward. Near textures are described with compact broken marks; farther detail becomes misty and soft-edged. Warm points of light bloom gently within the cool field and repeat below as elongated, fragmented reflections on a dark glossy plane. Ambient illumination is diffuse and low, with local glow replacing hard directional highlights. The strongest contrast gathers around a middle focal zone, then relaxes toward both the dark foreground and hazy distance. Details remain readable without uniformly sharp outlines; edges alternate between crisp illuminated accents and blue shadow loss. The overall effect is nocturnal, layered, and quietly dramatic, its spatial depth carried by reflection and warm-cool contrast.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅绘画依靠靛蓝、石板色、紫灰与少量琥珀金色光点组成深沉蓝调时刻色域。高大深色团块围住中央后退的空隙，重复的窄竖线和汇聚线条把视线向内拉。近处肌理由紧凑断续笔痕交代，更远细节变得朦胧且软边。暖色光点在冷色域中轻轻晕开，并在下方深色光亮平面上重复成长而破碎的倒影。环境照明漫射且低暗，局部发光替代硬朗定向高光。最强反差聚在中部焦点区，然后向深暗前景与朦胧远处松开。细节可辨，却没有全程均匀清晰的描边；边缘在受光的锐利重音与蓝色阴影中的消失之间变化。整体效果有夜色、层次与安静戏剧性，纵深由倒影和冷暖对照承担。
theme_en: A tram moving down a wet blue-hour city street
theme_zh: 一辆电车驶过蓝调时刻湿润的城市街道
name: Evgeny Lushpin
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
